item.title: No Man's Sky REMNANT Update Adds Gravity Gun & More
item.description: The latest update for No Man's Sky, Remnant, adds a gravity gun and new gameplay loop.

item.title: Disney+ Quietly Removed 3D From Apple Vision Pro In Europe
item.description: 3D support has been removed from Disney+ on Apple Vision Pro in several European countries, weakening one of the headset’s standout features.

item.title: Meta CTO: We're Still Investing More In VR Content Than Anyone Else
item.description: Meta CTO Andrew Bosworth claims that even after the cuts, the company is still investing more in VR content than anyone else, and more than it was 4 years ago.

item.title: Narrative Puzzle Game Tin Hearts: Act 1 Marches Onto Quest
item.description: Charming clockwork puzzler Tin Hearts: Act 1 arrives on Quest today, bringing its heartfelt story and inventive Lemmings-like gameplay to standalone headsets.

item.title: nDreams' Chaotic Sandbox Wreckin' Raccoon Is Out Now On Quest
item.description: Unhinged chaos sim Wreckin' Raccoon, nDreams' answer to games like I Am Cat and Gorilla Tag, has left Early Access for full release on Quest.

item.title: Titan Isles Is Coming To PlayStation VR2 This Month
item.description: Titan Isles brings its high-speed aerial combat to PlayStation VR2 this month.

item.title: Meta CTO Seems To Confirm Quest 4 Is Still On The Roadmap
item.description: In an interview with Alex Heath, Meta CTO Andrew Bosworth seemed to confirm the leak that a gaming-focused Quest 4 is still on the roadmap.

item.title: Meta CTO: We'll Learn From Steam Frame If It's Successful
item.description: Meta CTO Andrew Bosworth says that, as with all new headsets, the company will "learn from" Steam Frame if it's successful.

item.title: Meta & EssilorLuxottica Sold 7 Million Smart Glasses In 2025
item.description: Meta and EssilorLuxottica sold more than 7 million smart glasses in 2025, and they were the "dominant driver" of the Ray-Ban owner's wholesale growth in H2.

item.title: YouTube Launches Official Apple Vision Pro App
item.description: Google's YouTube launched an official app for Apple Vision Pro headsets, just over two years after the original's launch.
